{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check that deduplication reduced the row count by 48 (the number of re-tested patients)
print(f"Original rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Deduplicated rows: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Rows removed: {len(df) - len(df_dedup)}")

# Check that we now have one row per patient
print(f"Unique patient_id after dedup: {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check arm distribution after deduplication
df_dedup['arm'].value_counts()"}
